preamble: You are a world-class app icon designer. App: tidytv, a free open-source phone app that cleans up an Android TV: turns off ads and bloat, one tap to undo. Feeling: friendly, light, trustworthy, a little playful. Palette: bright blue #2F6BFF with deep ink #1B1B3A, white, ONE accent (sunny yellow #FFD54A or fresh green #22C55E). Deliver a single square app icon, full-bleed colour field, no rounded corners, no border, no text, no letters, no transparency, key shape inside the central 70 percent, bold silhouette readable at 40 px, no thin lines, no tiny details. Match the craft, simplicity and depth of the attached references; do NOT copy their subjects, logos or colours.

jobs.prompt: CONCEPT: a cheerful TV character, a rounded-rectangle TV screen in blue with a thick ink outline, two oval eyes and a small smile, two short stubby legs, on a sunny yellow field. Flat bold treatment, saturated, one soft shadow.

CONCEPT: a cheerful TV character, a soft glossy rounded TV with a blue screen face, two oval eyes and a small smile. Soft 3D frosted depth with gentle rim light on a pale blue to white gradient field.
CONCEPT: a clean TV silhouette in white on a bright blue field, its screen sparkling clean with one bold four-point yellow sparkle at the top right corner of the TV. Flat bold treatment.
CONCEPT: a TV screen as a soft layered glass card with one big four-point sparkle star glowing in its centre, duotone blue and white, gentle layered depth like modern macOS icons.

CONCEPT: a TV screen being wiped clean: the left half is cluttered with small grey dots, a bold curved white swoosh wipes across and the right half is clear bright blue. Ink outline TV, flat bold, green accent on the swoosh tip.
CONCEPT: a rounded TV in deep ink colour whose screen shows one big fresh green check mark, on a bright blue field, soft depth with a gentle glow from the screen.
